facts.fact: Incoming investors, led by the DNI Consortium with Metier Capital Growth Fund III partnerships and EM-Three Investment Holdings (all South African), subscribed for new shares in Frogfoot and Vox/Hypa, with RMB as adviser and funder; no subscription amount is stated, and the R8.4 billion is an implied combined after-debt equity value; the date is not stated, so the published date 2026-08-24 is used.

note: No money committed fact: the document states no amount subscribed, only a valuation.
